outputLimitErrors.rule: Strict is primary; any confirmed output limit makes every consuming contestant/item an error. Product-final preserves the original verdict, including fallback.

modelAmendment.authorization: Owner requests separate claude-sonnet-5-5 and gpt-6.1-sol cells after Haiku and Flash Lite finish; stop and report projection if a cell would exceed 25 USD.
modelAmendment.scoring: strict headline: every consumed output-limit hit is an error; product-final preserves the product fallback; same rule for both contestants
modelAmendment.retry: Owner network amendment supersedes prior no-answer attempt limits; answered outputs never resubmitted; 402 stops immediately.
modelAmendment.projection: Five representative frozen DEV requests first. Estimate 379-unit spend by their per-stage costs times the gpt-6-luna recorded request counts; unsampled cascade stages use the highest sampled cascade cost. Re-estimate from complete 20-item pilot before proceeding.
modelAmendment.multiplicity: Additional model, separate from original 18-cell family; adjustment pending collator
modelAmendment.thinkingNote: Adaptive Sonnet 5.5 ignores positive MAX_THINKING_TOKENS. Total output cap bounds thinking plus answer; no 65536-token request is sent.

price.status: Measured native total_cost_usd per call; five-call gate required

modelAmendment.lean: Fresh empty directory; unchanged frozen judge system prompt; tools empty; settings sources empty; strict MCP; no session persistence; one turn
modelAmendment.networkAmendment: Ten healthy provider probes spaced 30 seconds apart before new calls, one model cell at a time, concurrency two. Three consecutive connection failures pause ten minutes and repeat the gate. Zero-token no-output transport requests retry missing-only without an attempt limit. Every answer stays cached.
modelAmendment.outerProcessNote: Queueing and network-health pauses must not kill a live wrapper and orphan its physical attempt. Actual provider attempts remain 300 seconds; the outer envelope uses the maximum supported Node timer.
